paragraphs.text: Kawabe Province an area on plane of Kamigawa , situated along the Yumegawa River between Lake Kamitaki and the sea.

Kawabe Province is where Lady Azami Ozu was from. It was here she met a river kami that tricked her into believing she would obtain all the world's knowledge in exchange for "everything". This led Azami on a quest for knowledge that led to the deaths of her mother, her friend Etsumi Urano , and the head librarian at Minamo , Atsuko Shimazaki , but also led to Azami's elevation into the head librarian of that esteemed academy.
